description: Ex-TAF/VOTEC DC-3 displayed inside the Apoena Ecopark adventure park (ticketed); visitors can enter the aircraft. Listed on the park's attractions page and in a Feb 2026 compilation. ABRAPAC 2019 quoted the registration as PT-KYW; PT-KZF per Monolito Nimbus and the 2026 compilation - identity to be confirmed on site.
aliases: DC3; C-47; C47; Dakota; Skytrain; PT-KYW; TAF; VOTEC
